cookie.title: Browser Session Cookie
cookie.description:
Authenticate directly using an active session cookie from your web browser.

**How to get your cookie:**
1. In your browser, log in to the PSE&G portal (mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com)
2. Press **F12** (or right-click → **Inspect**) to open Developer Tools
3. Click the **Network** tab, then refresh the page (F5)
4. Click any request to mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com (e.g. `Dashboard`)
5. In **Request Headers**, copy the full value of the `Cookie:` header and paste it below.
